services.desc: Free admission! Tell your friends about our $1000 Sponsorship. Buy a drink to support this event. Featuring Paul Parker on drums, Doug Mathews on bass, Ed Krout on keyboards, Dan Jordan on sax and flute and special guests. The band opens the night with a concert set, which is then followed by a jazz jam session. Musicians, bring your instruments and your favorite jazz standard and sit in! Sign-up opens at 7:15pm.
